name: Brave Search API
tier_rationale: P307 cond 5 and P287 cond 7: Brave trusted - established company with its own web index, published API terms, plans and privacy policy (A8).

reliability.justification: First-party web index; results are URL/title leads to verify, never facts about the target.

error_markers.reason: Brave Search: plan quota or monthly credits exhausted

brave_search.description: Brave Search API subscription token (sent in the X-Subscription-Token header)
brave_search.plan_hint: company account; record the business plan in key_plans (P307 cond 2)

web.title: Brave web search /res/v1/web/search (X-Subscription-Token)

terms.quote: veto_lift (2): engines are limited to first-party APIs with their own index and business-compatible terms: Brave Search API (preferred; X-Subscription-Token header; class key-terms, business plan recorded in key_plans)

web.notes: Quote: binding council text (P307 cond 2). P307 cond 6: results are never cached raw (http_profile ttl 0) and only URL + title of returned results are kept (no snippets) unless a storage-rights plan is recorded. Without a token the API answers 422 VALIDATION naming the x-subscription-token header (research p3-G14-1, 2026-11-26): that is NEEDS_KEY, never an absence; 401/402/403 likewise. 429 RATE_LIMITED / QUOTA_LIMITED codes come from the provider documentation (not observed without a key). Free plan: US$5 credits per month (~1,000 queries), 1 query/s.

notes: Created by batch p9-G13-3 for P287's search fallback ('only through P307's Brave Search source', P287 cond 3) from the p3-G14-1 prep registry draft, so P307 web_search_api and P289 employee_xray extend it (brave_search__<batch>.json) instead of declaring the host again. No SerpApi or other CAPTCHA-solving SERP service exists in the registry (P307 cond 1). Search engines are never scraped.
